question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 10.**
solution:
The correct answer is:** to reach**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the correct use of the given words.
 
 
• '**Reach**' means arriving at a place or condition you have been going towards.
 
• '**Reached**' is the past and past participle form of reach. It is used in a sentence only written in the past tense.
 
• **'To reach'** indicates a goal or a direction of movement, as well as a place of arrival. (to achieve the goal)
 
• **'To reaching'** here, 'reaching'(verb+ing) is a gerund and it is only used in a continuous tense. Although 'to reaching' is basically a grammatically incorrect word. We either use 'to reach' or simply 'reaching'
 
 
 
• The given sentence is talking about WHO's goal regarding the polio vaccine, So, **'to reach'** should be the most appropriate word.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **The WHO wants to give the polio vaccination to every kid in the globe and guarantee that there will be no polio in the future.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

Complete passage: *Polio was once a disease feared worldwide, striking suddenly and paralysing mainly children (1) for __life. WHO is a partner in the Global Polio Eradication Initiative, the __(2) largest__ private-public partnership for health, which has __(3) reduced__ polio by 99%. Polio now survives __(4) only __among the world's three poorest and __(5) most__ marginalised communities, where it stalks the most __(6) vulnerable__ children. These are - Afghanistan, Nigeria and Pakistan. __(7)Until__ poliovirus transmission is interrupted in these countries, all __(8) countries__ remain at risk of importation of polio, __(9) Especially__ vulnerable countries with weak public health and immunisation services. WHO's goal is __**(10)to reach**__ every last child with polio vaccine and ensure a polio-free world for future generations.*
